summary: EXPERIMENTER: design the BEST plugin restructure so we collect a reusable technique DATABASE — each technique stored with its MEANING (what/when/why) + CODE for 100% reproduction. Council of architects proposes the library schema (components/combos/rules/INDEX), how /award-re:learn writes new ones, how section-builder pulls them, how brain 163 .md links to body. ZERO code rewrite — outputs the architecture spec + migration plan.

archs.angle: DATABASE-FIRST. The library stops being "6 folders + scattered .md" and becomes a queryable technique DATABASE with ONE machine-readable index as the entry point. Every primitive is a self-describing folder whose RECIPE.md carries a strict YAML front-matter (the row), variants are nested sub-entries under the same technique-id, MEANING is structured fields (not prose), and INDEX.md is the generated lookup the agent reads first. The 163 .md brain is NOT touched — it stays as the "why/grammar" layer and is LINKED bidirectionally to the body by id. The plugin's job changes from "advise a technique in prose, re-derive the code" to "look up technique-id in INDEX → open folder → import the parameterized component → wire it". Reproduction is guaranteed because the row points at runnable code + lab + acceptance gates, and a verify script fails CI if any row's referenced files/labs are missing or broken. Core principle: a technique is reproducible ONLY if it is (a) one row in the index, (b) one folder with parameterized code, (c) one runnable lab, (d) acceptance gates a script can check. Prose alone = not in the database.
archs.librarySchema:
library/ becomes a 5-zone database. ZONES:

library/
  INDEX.md                  ← THE generated lookup table (machine-readable MD table; one row per technique+variant). Single entry point. NEVER hand-edited — emitted by scripts/library-index.mjs from front-matters.
  INDEX.json                ← same data, JSON (the agent/section-builder reads this; MD is the human mirror). Generated in the same pass.
  components/<technique-id>/ ← LEVEL-1 PRIMITIVES (atomic, one technique). Strict folder contract:
      RECIPE.md             ← front-matter (the row) + MEANING + phases + gotchas + acceptance
      component.js          ← parameterized, self-contained IIFE+ESM dual (no bundler). export function mount(root, opts){...} returns {destroy}
      component.css         ← tokenized (consumes --aw-* vars, ships sane defaults)
      lab.html              ← runnable standalone demo (opens via file://, real assets), exposes window.__LAB_OK__
      tokens.json           ← the parameter surface: every knob with type/default/range/meaning (machine-readable contract for opts)
      variants/<variant-id>/  ← OPTIONAL. Each variant = {variant.recipe.md (delta front-matter) + variant.js OR params.json + variant.lab.html}. See variantStrategy.
  combos/<combo-id>/        ← LEVEL-2 SECTION recipes. Folder (was flat .md). Contains:
      RECIPE.md             ← combo front-matter: ordered `uses:[technique-id@variant ...]`, who-owns-the-pin, theme, choreography
      lab.html              ← the assembled section running (proves the stack works together)
  rules/                    ← LEVEL-3 GATES (unchanged set of 8 .md). Each rule gets a small front-matter `gates:` block listing which RECIPE fields it constrains (e.g. R_pin_budget gates `pin:true` count). Machine-checkable.
  tokens/                   ← GLOBAL design tokens (the --aw-* surface: ease names, durations, type scale, theme vars) so every component.css and lab share ONE token file. tokens/_tokens.css + tokens/_tokens.json.

Rule: components = atomic (1 technique), combos = stacks (cite components, never inline their code), rules = gates (constrain front-matter). A technique EXISTS in the DB only when its folder has all 5 contract files AND it appears as a row in INDEX. Self-contained = no build step; component.js is dual IIFE/ESM so vanilla+Vite apps `import { mount }` OR `<script>` it.
archs.recipeHeader:
Every RECIPE.md opens with a YAML front-matter block (between `---` fences) = the machine row. Exact fields (order fixed so the index generator is trivial):

```
---
id: cards-swipe                      # unique kebab; = folder name
name: "Pinned cinematic deck-swipe"  # human title
level: 1                             # 1=primitive, 2=combo
status: official                     # seed | wip | official | deprecated
meaning:                             # the WHEN-to-reach-for-it brain
  what: "Pinned scrub timeline: render dissolves, card slides up, becomes a horizontal swiped deck."
  when: "A services/benefits/chapters section that must read as ONE cinematic takeover, not a list."
  lands: "The page 'becomes a film' for one section; chapters feel authored, premium, sequential."
  not_when: "Short factual sections, conversion gates (motion must DROP there), >half the page pinning."
source:                              # provenance = reproducibility anchor
  grammar: "Zera Studio — zerasoftwarestudio.com 'Our Services'"
  recording: "rec1-cards-swipe.mov"  # the .mov this was recorded 1:1 from (or null)
  registry_ref: "T-### / _TECHNIQUE_REGISTRY.md line"  # link INTO the 163 brain
stack: "vanilla + GSAP 3.12.5 + ScrollTrigger + CustomEase + guarded Lenis"
webgl: false
motion_props: [transform, opacity, clip-path]   # the ONLY allowed animated props (perf contract)
trigger: "one pinned scroll-scrub timeline (scrub:1), reversible"
timing_layer: [B-entrance, A-ambient]           # which STACKING-GRAMMAR layers it fills (A/B/C)
owns_pin: true                                  # for combo pin-budget math
combines_with: [puzzle-text, focus-render-switch, theme-flip]
anti_combos: [before-after-drag, second-pin]    # gesture/pin collisions
variants: [v1-7phase, v2-cinematic, v3-editorial, v4-depth]
files: [component.js, component.css, lab.html, tokens.json]
params_ref: tokens.json                         # the knob contract
acceptance:                                      # gates a script/human can check
  - "render dissolves via 2-img crossfade, never video.currentTime"
  - "reverse-scroll replays all phases 1:1"
  - "≤760px collapses to static vertical stack"
verify: lab.html#__LAB_OK__                      # how library-verify proves it runs
---
```
Below the fence: the existing human prose (one-sentence, phases, easing, DOM, GSAP, gotchas, content-wiring) is KEPT as-is. The front-matter is purely additive — zero rewrite of the good prose already in cards-swipe/RECIPE.md.
archs.indexFormat:
library/INDEX.md = ONE generated table, the single lookup. Columns are exactly the join the agent needs: technique → registry-line → component path → NW status → variants → meaning one-liner. Format:

| id | name | lvl | status | webgl | path | variants | owns_pin | timing | combines_with | registry | meaning (when→lands) |
|----|------|-----|--------|-------|------|----------|----------|--------|---------------|----------|----------------------|
| cards-swipe | Pinned cinematic deck-swipe | 1 | official | no | components/cards-swipe/ | v1-7phase,v2-cinematic,v3-editorial,v4-depth | yes | A,B | puzzle-text,focus-render-switch | T-042 | chapters section → page 'becomes a film' |
| focus-render-switch | … | 1 | official | no | components/focus-render-switch/ | — | no | C | parallax,theme-flip | T-077 | spec/option toggle → render snaps in focus |
| hero-puzzle-monument | … | 2 | official | no | combos/hero-puzzle-monument/ | — | yes | A,B | (uses: puzzle-image,puzzle-text) | — | hero → monument assembles from fragments |

Plus a generated INDEX.json mirror keyed by id (`{ "cards-swipe": { ...full front-matter... } }`) — that is what section-builder actually parses; the MD is the human/PR-diff view. Both emitted by scripts/library-index.mjs in one pass over every RECIPE front-matter. The table is sorted level then id. A row missing its path/files makes the verify script FAIL — so INDEX can never drift from disk.
archs.variantStrategy:
One technique-id = one folder = MULTIPLE variants, stored as DELTAS, never duplicated full copies. Convention:

components/cards-swipe/
  component.js / .css / tokens.json     ← the BASE (the canonical v1, fully parameterized)
  variants/
    v2-cinematic/
      variant.recipe.md   ← delta front-matter ONLY: `extends: cards-swipe`, `variant: v2-cinematic`, changed meaning.lands, changed source.recording, plus an `overrides:` block of token values that differ from base
      params.json         ← the token diff (e.g. {"dissolveDur":0.45,"ghostLetterOpacity":0.10,"ease":"cinematic"}) — preferred form when a variant is JUST different knobs
      variant.lab.html    ← runnable proof of THIS variant
    v3-editorial/
      variant.recipe.md
      variant.js          ← only when the variant needs NEW code beyond params (e.g. different DOM); it imports the base mount and patches, never forks wholesale
      variant.lab.html
    v4-depth/ …

Decision rule (encoded in the schema): if a variant differs only by token values → `params.json` (data, zero code). If it adds/removes a DOM layer or a phase → `variant.js` that `import { mount } from '../../component.js'` and extends. A full fork is BANNED — DRY is enforced because variant.recipe.md MUST carry `extends:` and either params.json or a variant.js that imports the base. The index lists every variant in the parent row's `variants:` column; each variant is NOT its own top-level row (keeps the DB keyed by technique, browsable by variant). cards-swipe v2/v3/v4 = three params.json (+ optional variant.js) under one folder = the first official multi-variant entry.
archs.meaningCapture:
MEANING is captured as STRUCTURED FIELDS in the front-matter `meaning:` block + `timing_layer` + `combines_with`/`anti_combos`, so the plugin knows WHEN to reach for a technique, not just how. Four meaning fields, each answering a planning question the section-builder actually asks:
- `what`  → the one-sentence mechanic (matches the existing "What it is" prose).
- `when`  → the SECTION SITUATION that calls for it ("chapters that must read as one takeover"). This is the lookup key during planning: section-builder matches the section's job-to-be-done against every row's `when`.
- `lands` → the EMOTIONAL/perceptual payoff ("page becomes a film"). Lets the director's-pass pick by intended feeling, and lets /audit check "did this section land what its technique promises".
- `not_when` → the anti-pattern guard (conversion gates, short factual sections, >half-pinned). Prevents misuse; cross-checks rules/.

These map onto the existing brain: `when`/`lands` are distilled from _TECHNIQUE_REGISTRY prose and the catalog-syndrome/dramaturgy lenses; `not_when` is the local mirror of rules/R_anti_combos + pin-budget. So MEANING is not new doctrine — it is the registry's prose compressed into machine-queryable fields, with `registry_ref` pointing back to the full prose for the human. Selection algorithm: planner reads section job → filters INDEX.json rows by `when` semantic match and `timing_layer` need (A/B/C) → excludes any whose `not_when` matches → ranks by `lands` vs director intent.
archs.reproducibilityGuarantee:
100% reproduction is guaranteed by FIVE artifacts that must ALL exist for a technique to be "official", enforced by one script:
1. PARAMETERIZED component.js — `mount(root, opts)` reads every knob from `opts` merged over tokens.json defaults; no magic numbers inline. Same opts → same render, deterministically.
2. tokens.json — the explicit knob contract (type, default, range, meaning per param). The agent fills opts from this; nothing is undocumented.
3. lab.html — a runnable standalone that mounts the component with real assets and sets `window.__LAB_OK__ = true` only after the technique's acceptance behaviors fire (e.g. dissolve completed, reverse replayed). Reproduction is OBSERVABLE, not asserted.
4. acceptance[] front-matter — the human-readable pass conditions (the "How to verify" already in cards-swipe, promoted to a list).
5. scripts/library-verify.mjs — CI gate that, for every INDEX row: confirms the 5 contract files exist; lints that component.js animates ONLY motion_props (greps for banned width/left/top/video.currentTime); opens each lab.html headless (Playwright, already a plugin dep) and asserts __LAB_OK__; checks variant deltas import the base. A red verify = the technique is NOT reproducible = it cannot be marked official and section-builder will refuse to import it. This turns "reproducible" from a hope into a passing test. STATUS lifecycle: seed → wip → official requires green verify; deprecated keeps the row but the agent won't auto-pick it.
archs.brainLink:
Bidirectional, by id, zero duplication. The 163 .md stay the WHY layer; the library/ is the WHAT/HOW body. Links:
DOWN (brain → body): _TECHNIQUE_REGISTRY.md gets ONE new column "impl" on each of its ~150 rows: either a library id (`cards-swipe`) or `—` (not yet recorded). That column is the coverage map — at a glance, which of the 150 prose techniques now have reproducible code. Skills that advise a technique (motion-engine E-entries, re-sections, variants-prototyping) add a footer line `IMPLEMENTED-BY: library/components/<id>/` where a primitive exists, so a skill reading agent jumps straight to code.
UP (body → brain): every RECIPE front-matter carries `source.registry_ref` (the registry line/T-id) and `source.grammar` (the originating site). So from any code folder you can walk back to the prose grammar that justifies it.
GLUE: scripts/library-index.mjs ALSO emits a COVERAGE.md report — registry techniques with no impl (the build backlog) and library entries with no registry_ref (orphans to reconcile). The rules/ files get `gates:` front-matter naming the RECIPE fields they constrain, so a rule and the rows it polices are linked too. Net: nothing is duplicated — prose lives once in the brain, code lives once in the body, and id-links + two generated reports (INDEX, COVERAGE) keep them honest.
archs.learnPipeline:
/award-re:learn gains a `--promote` mode = the one-pass pipeline that turns a winning prototype/recording into an official DB entry. Input: a chosen prototype file (from prototype-engine/variants-prototyping output) OR a reference-site recording (.mov) the user blessed. Steps (single pass):
1. CLASSIFY — is this a NEW technique (new id) or a VARIANT of an existing id? (ask/diff against INDEX). 
2. EXTRACT — pull the parameterized component out of the prototype: lift magic numbers into tokens.json, wrap as mount(root,opts), split component.js/.css. For a recording, record it 1:1 first (the cards-swipe 7-phase method) then extract.
3. WRITE RECIPE — generate the full front-matter (meaning.what/when/lands/not_when from the user's framing + registry match, source.recording = the .mov, registry_ref, motion_props, combines_with via the stackability matrix, acceptance[] from observed behaviors).
4. LAB — emit lab.html (or variants/<id>/variant.lab.html) wiring real assets + the __LAB_OK__ acceptance probe.
5. VERIFY — run library-verify on the new folder; loop until green (this is the 100%-reproduction gate; a prototype that won't pass verify is not promoted, it goes back to wip).
6. REGISTER — re-run library-index.mjs → new INDEX row (or variant added to parent row) + INDEX.json + COVERAGE update; set the registry `impl` column; add IMPLEMENTED-BY footer to the relevant skill. 
7. RULES — if the new technique introduces a new collision, append to R_anti_combos / combines_with of partners.
One command, one commit: prototype → primitive + INDEX row + registry link + variant slot. This is the growth loop that stops every build re-deriving the generic version.
archs.agentWiring:
section-builder agent gets a hard amendment: IMPORT-AND-COMPOSE FROM LIBRARY BEFORE WRITING ANY NEW CODE. New mandatory first steps in the agent's loop:
1. RESOLVE — given the section's job-to-be-done + chosen timing layers (A/B/C) + director intent, query library/INDEX.json: filter rows by meaning.when match + timing_layer, exclude not_when hits, rank by lands. Output: a candidate technique-id (or a combo id) + variant.
2. CHECK COMBO — if a combos/ recipe already covers this section job, use it (it cites the component ids + owns-pin + choreography). Don't re-stack by hand.
3. IMPORT — `import { mount } from 'library/components/<id>/component.js'` and the component.css/tokens; fill opts from tokens.json. NEVER copy-derive a simpler inline version — that is the exact failure this whole DB exists to kill.
4. GATE — before finalizing, run the stack through rules/ (pin-budget: ≤1 owns_pin per section, theme-flow, anti_combos). The perf-guard/eval-brain agents read motion_props from the rows to lint.
5. GAP PATH — if RESOLVE finds NO row with status:official matching the job, the agent does NOT silently hand-roll. It builds via prototype-engine, and on user approval routes through /award-re:learn --promote so the new technique enters the DB (every build either reuses or grows the library — never re-derives privately).
Enforcement: a hook (extend the 3 existing gate .js) fails the section build if a motion-heavy section ships with zero `import` from library/ and no matching prototype-promotion — i.e. "you reinvented a primitive" is a blocked state.
risks: INDEX drift: hand-editing INDEX.md or forgetting to regen after a RECIPE edit silently desyncs the DB. Mitigation: INDEX is GENERATED-only (banner header), library-verify fails if INDEX != front-matters, run it in the learn pipeline + a pre-commit hook.

Front-matter rot: 6 existing RECIPEs have inconsistent/absent headers; retrofitting by hand risks typos that break the generator. Mitigation: a strict schema (fixed field order) + library-verify schema-lint catches malformed YAML before it lands.

__LAB_OK__ theater: a lab that sets the flag without truly exercising acceptance gives false green. Mitigation: the probe must be wired to observed behaviors (e.g. assert dissolve layer opacity reached 1, reverse replayed), reviewed in the promote pass; acceptance[] strings must each map to a probe.

Variant explosion / fork temptation: agents may copy a whole component for a variant instead of params.json delta, re-introducing duplication. Mitigation: schema BANS forks (variant.recipe.md must carry extends: + params.json or a base-importing variant.js); verify checks the import exists.

Over-restriction of the agent: forcing import-from-library could block legitimately novel sections and produce same-y output. Mitigation: the GAP PATH — no match → prototype → promote, so novelty flows INTO the DB rather than being blocked or hidden.

No-bundler dual-format breakage: IIFE+ESM dual component.js can be fragile across vanilla <script> and Vite import. Mitigation: lab.html tests the file:// IIFE path, a tiny Vite smoke-import tests the ESM path; both in verify.

WebGL primitives (OrbitStage) break the transform/opacity perf contract and the static-collapse assumption. Mitigation: webgl:true rows get a separate perf gate + mandatory reduced-motion/mobile fallback field in acceptance; perf-guard branches on the webgl flag.

Brain-body coverage debt ignored: COVERAGE.md backlog (150 prose vs few impl) could be shelved forever. Mitigation: surface COVERAGE count in /award-re:help/audit so the gap is visible; learn --promote is the steady drip that closes it.

archs.angle: COMPOSITION-FIRST. The library has a real inversion problem hidden in plain sight: there are 6 atom dirs but 7 combos, and several combos already name primitives that have NO component dir (parallax-depth, splitLines, appear, theme, reveal, custom-cursor, counter, scroll-indicator). The brain ADVISES techniques as prose; the body must let you BUILD A SECTION BY PICKING A COMBO that pulls 4-5 atoms onto ONE shared pin/progress, with rules/ gating every stack edge. So the schema makes the COMBO the primary buildable unit (a section = a combo) and the COMPONENT the referenced atom. Crucially the rules I read (R_stackability, R_anti_combos, R_stacking_grammar, STACKING-GRAMMAR) already encode the laws — but combos reference them only in prose, never by path, and there is NO index. Three concrete gaps to close: (1) every combo and component needs a machine-readable header so the section-builder can resolve "combo -> uses[] atoms -> gated-by[] rules" without re-reading prose; (2) the missing-atom primitives the combos cite must become first-class component dirs (parallax-depth, splitLines, appear/decode-gate, theme-flip, reveal, custom-cursor) OR be declared shared-utilities in a manifest so 'uses' never dangles; (3) reproducibility must hold at BOTH altitudes — an atom reproduces a MOVE (lab.html proves it in isolation), a combo reproduces a SECTION (its own combo-lab.html proves the 5 atoms fire on one progress). Meaning lives twice too: atom meaning = 'what this move lands', combo meaning = 'what section job this stack does + which beat of the page'. The INDEX is dual: INDEX-components (atom lookup) + INDEX-combos (section lookup), the combo index being the one the builder reads first.
archs.librarySchema:
library/ gains a manifest + dual index + combo labs, NO code rewrite:

library/
  INDEX.md                  -> top router: links to the two real indexes + how to read
  INDEX-combos.md           -> PRIMARY lookup (section job -> combo)
  INDEX-components.md       -> atom lookup (move -> component)
  manifest.json             -> machine registry: every component id, every combo id, every rule id, their files + status + uses/gated-by edges (single source the section-builder + verify script parse)
  components/<id>/           -> ATOM (a single MOVE). Existing 6 keep shape, add header to RECIPE:
      component.js  component.css  lab.html  RECIPE.md
      variants/<variant-id>/   -> NEW. one technique, many recordings (cinematic/editorial/depth)
          VARIANT.md  + optional override .css/.js partial + variant-lab.html
  combos/<id>/              -> PROMOTE flat combos/<id>.md INTO a dir (composition is first-class):
      RECIPE.md            -> the existing prose stack (unchanged body, gains header)
      combo-lab.html       -> NEW: runnable section proving the 4-5 atoms on ONE progress (imports atom component.js/.css by relative path, wires shared pin)
  rules/<id>.md            -> unchanged prose, but each gains a 5-line YAML front-matter (id, kind, gates, severity) so combos can cite them by id and a script can enforce
  shared/                  -> NEW: the primitives combos cite but that are not yet atom dirs (parallax-depth, splitLines, appear, theme-flip, reveal, custom-cursor, counter, scroll-indicator) live here as small self-contained util .js/.css + a one-screen UTIL.md each, until promoted to full components/. Manifest marks them kind:"shared-util" so 'uses' never dangles.

Naming: component id = kebab move name (cards-swipe). combo id = job-noun (hero-puzzle-monument). variant id = adjective (cinematic). rule id = R_*. All ids are globally unique across the manifest.

archs.indexFormat:
DUAL index, both Markdown tables a human reads and a script greps; the manifest.json holds the same edges machine-canonically.

INDEX-combos.md (PRIMARY — the builder opens this first; one row = one buildable section):
| section job (page beat) | combo id | atoms it pulls (pin-owner FIRST) | theme | pins | gated-by | lands (one line) | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

archs.variantStrategy:
One technique = one component dir; multiple recordings = sub-dirs under variants/, NEVER duplicate the base. The base component.js/.css is the parameterized engine; a variant is a NAMED PARAM PRESET + optional thin override, plus its own proof.

components/cards-swipe/
  component.js / component.css      <- the ONE engine (unchanged, params drive everything)
  RECIPE.md                         <- base recipe + header with variants:[cinematic,editorial,depth]
  lab.html                          <- base/default proof
  variants/
    cinematic/  VARIANT.md  variant-lab.html  [override.css]
    editorial/  VARIANT.md  variant-lab.html  [override.css]
    depth/      VARIANT.md  variant-lab.html  [override.css]

VARIANT.md front-matter is a thin delta, not a re-recipe:
---
variant_of: cards-swipe
id: cinematic
meaning_delta: "slower scrub, heavier dissolve, dark-only — reads filmic vs editorial's brisk paper feel"
param_overrides: { scrubPerCard: 1.4, blurFrom: 20, ease: air, theme: dark }
css_override: override.css        # optional, only the diff selectors
source: "rec1 nahirna v3 recording"
when_pick_this: "hero-adjacent, emotional; pick editorial for a brisk services index instead"
status: verified
---
Rule: a variant MUST be reproducible by params alone wherever possible; an override file is allowed ONLY for genuinely structural CSS the params can't reach, and it must be a partial (diff selectors), never a fork of component.css. The manifest lists each variant with its param_overrides so the section-builder can apply a variant by merging params — no second engine. This is exactly how V2-cinematic / V3-editorial / V4-depth get recorded as 3 legit entries of ONE technique.
archs.meaningCapture:
Meaning is captured as a 4-field block (what / for_what / when_to_use / what_it_lands) in EVERY header, at BOTH altitudes, and that 4th field is the WHEN-trigger the owner asked for — it tells the plugin when to REACH for a technique, not just how to run it.

- what: the mechanic in one sentence (the 'how' summary).
- for_what: the content/communication job it serves (e.g. 'show N scenes as a reel, not a grid').
- when_to_use: the SELECTION condition — the section's job + the data you must have on hand (e.g. 'first section + one strong full-bleed render'). This is the decision key the section-builder matches a brief against.
- what_it_lands: the emotional/perceptual payoff ('you recognize the house before it finishes'). This is the acceptance the verify step proves.

At COMBO altitude an extra field — page_beat (hero/proof/material/lifestyle-climax/conversion/bridge) — maps the combo onto the page's dramaturgy, so the builder can lay out a whole page as a SEQUENCE of beats and pick one combo per beat, honoring R_theme_flow's temperature wave and R_pin_budget's 'one pin in three'. Meaning therefore answers three questions the prose registry couldn't index: WHEN do I reach for this (when_to_use), WHERE in the page does it sit (page_beat), and HOW DO I KNOW IT WORKED (what_it_lands -> verify). The prose body keeps the rich frame-by-frame 'how'; the header makes the 'when/where/why' machine-selectable.
archs.reproducibilityGuarantee:
Five locks, layered atom+combo, enforced by one script:

1. PARAMETERIZED ENGINE — every component is a self-contained IIFE/ESM with an explicit params object (the header's params list is the contract surface). No magic numbers buried; the lab passes the documented params. Reproduce = call with the same params.
2. TOKENS — eases/durations/parallax amounts come from named tokens (ease:'air', the CustomEase strings in RECIPE), never ad-hoc per-build. A combo declares ONE ease in its header; R_timing_layers gates that no second ease appears.
3. RUNNABLE LABS AT BOTH ALTITUDES — atom lab.html proves the MOVE in isolation with real media; combo-lab.html proves the SECTION (4-5 atoms imported by relative path, wired to ONE shared progress). If the combo-lab runs, the composition is reproducible, not just the parts.
4. RECIPE PITFALLS + VERIFY — every RECIPE carries the Gotchas list and a header verify: array of acceptance gates (one-pin-only, seamless-seated, fps-holds, no-layout-anim). These are the SAME gates hooks/gate.js + the section-builder DoD already enforce — now declared per-technique.
5. library-verify.mjs (NEW, ~80 lines, no deps) — walks manifest.json and asserts: every component dir has its 4 files; every combo dir has RECIPE+combo-lab; every uses atom resolves to a real component or shared-util (closes the parallax-depth/splitLines dangling gap); every gated_by rule id exists; every combo has exactly ONE stack entry with owns_pin:true (single-pin law, machine-checked); every header carries the 4 meaning fields + status. Commit-gate runs it. 100% reproduction = manifest resolves + both labs run + verify passes.

MIGRATION (retrofit the 6 + record V3/V2, zero code rewrite):
Step 1 — promote combos/<id>.md flat files into combos/<id>/RECIPE.md (git mv), body untouched.
Step 2 — add the YAML header to each of the 6 component RECIPEs and 7 combo RECIPEs (additive only).
Step 3 — create shared/ and move the 8 cited-but-dir-less primitives (parallax-depth, splitLines, appear, theme-flip, reveal, custom-cursor, counter, scroll-indicator) in as shared-utils with a one-screen UTIL.md each, so every combo 'uses' resolves.
Step 4 — add the 5-line front-matter to each of the 8 rules/ files.
Step 5 — write manifest.json (the 6 components + 7 combos + 8 rules + 8 shared-utils + edges) and the dual INDEX + root INDEX.
Step 6 — write library-verify.mjs; run it; fix dangles until green.
Step 7 — FIRST OFFICIAL ENTRIES: record cards-swipe V3-editorial and V2-cinematic as variants/ under the existing cards-swipe engine (VARIANT.md + param_overrides + variant-lab.html, NO engine fork) — proving the variant mechanism on the very technique the owner is recording now. Then back-fill registry_tid IMPLEMENTED-BY links into _REGISTRY_TID.md.
Each step is a separate commit; verify must be green before the commit lands.
archs.brainLink:
The 163 .md stay as the verified MAP; the library is the EXECUTABLE INDEX into it — bidirectional pointers, zero duplication.

DOWN (brain -> body): _REGISTRY_TID.md (109 T-ID) and _GRAMMAR.md gain an IMPLEMENTED-BY column: each T-ID / archetype that now has code points to a component or combo id (e.g. T-card-swipe -> components/cards-swipe). A T-ID with no code says 'advice-only (not yet recorded)'. STACKING-GRAMMAR §6 'recombination principle' and the canonical 5-stack point at the combos that realize it. This turns the prose registry into a coverage map: which of the 150 techniques are STORED vs still only ADVISED.

UP (body -> brain): every component/combo header carries registry_tid:[...] and source:, so each code entry cites its prose origin. gated_by:[R_*] cites the rule file by id. combines_with / anti_combos cite other library ids. The header is the join table.

Rules bridge: the 8 rules/ files are the body-resident enforcement of the brain's grammar laws (R_anti_combos = STACKING-GRAMMAR §1 matrix made gate-able by id; R_pin_budget = §3; R_theme_flow = §4; R_perf_limits = §5). Add the 5-line YAML front-matter to each rule so combos cite it and library-verify enforces it. The brain explains WHY a law exists (prose, anatomy of AIR/Ever); the rule file is the machine-checkable WHAT; the combo's gated_by is the WHERE-it-applies. No law is duplicated — the rule file is the single canonical copy, the brain links to it, the combo references it by id.

manifest.json is the spine connecting all three: components + combos + rules + their edges + their registry_tid back-links, in one parseable file the section-builder and verify script both read.
archs.learnPipeline:
/award-re:learn gains a 4th mode — `promote` — that turns a winning prototype/recording into a library primitive in ONE pass, parallel to the existing failure/video-bug/video-teardown modes.

Input: a chosen prototype (a winning prototypes/*.html from a section build) OR a reference recording teardown OR a hardened section just shipped. Argument names the source + the target id + whether it's a new component, a new variant, or a new combo.

Pass (single, idempotent):
1. CLASSIFY altitude: does this reproduce a single MOVE (-> component or variant) or a STACK of moves on one progress (-> combo)? Heuristic: counts pin-owners and clocks; >1 atom on one progress = combo.
2. EXTRACT code: pull the prototype's engine into components/<id>/component.{js,css} (IIFE/ESM, no bundler) OR, if it's a preset of an existing engine, write only variants/<id>/VARIANT.md + param_overrides (NO engine copy). If combo: write combos/<id>/RECIPE.md + combo-lab.html that imports the atoms by relative path.
3. CARVE the lab: lab.html (atom) or combo-lab.html (section) made runnable with real media paths, reduced-motion + mobile branches present.
4. WRITE the header: fill all required header fields, ESPECIALLY the 4 meaning fields + when_to_use + (for combos) page_beat + the single owns_pin entry. Set status: seed until verified.
5. LINK: append a row to INDEX-components.md or INDEX-combos.md; add the entry + edges to manifest.json; back-fill registry_tid IMPLEMENTED-BY in _REGISTRY_TID.md; cite gated_by rule ids.
6. VERIFY + gate: run library-verify.mjs; if it passes (files present, uses resolve, one pin, meaning complete) flip status seed->verified. If a NEW recurring rule emerged, propose a rules/ patch (same escalation path the failure-mode already uses for constitution patches).
7. COMMIT+push the plugin repo with a CHANGELOG 'library ingestion #N' line (mirrors the existing teardown ingestion log).

Result: one command, prototype in -> a verified, indexed, brain-linked, gate-passing library entry out. This is the growth loop that stops every build from re-deriving the generic version.
archs.agentWiring:
section-builder v2 -> v3: add a MANDATORY 'compose-from-library-before-writing' step at the TOP of its INPUT/TASK contract, inverting its default from 'write code to the layer-stack' to 'resolve the layer-stack to library ids, import them, write ONLY the glue'.

New contract additions:
- INPUT (additional required read): library/INDEX-combos.md + library/manifest.json. The section's motion-score layer-stack row must be RESOLVED to a combo id (or, if none fits, to an explicit ordered list of component ids). No-match -> propose a /award-re:learn promote, don't hand-roll silently.
- TASK rewrite: 'Implement the assigned stack by (a) picking the combo whose section_job matches, (b) importing its pin-owner atom + rider atoms from components/<id>/ by relative path, (c) wiring them to ONE shared pin-progress per the combo RECIPE, (d) writing ONLY the section-specific glue + content. Writing a new primitive from scratch is a LAST resort and must be flagged for promotion.'
- BANS (extend the battle-failure ban list): 'Re-deriving an atom that exists in components/ (reinvention ban) — if INDEX-components has the move, import it.' 'A second pin/owns_pin in one section (now machine-checkable against the combo header).' 'Citing a rule the section violates (gated_by must hold).'
- DoD additions: [ ] every layer maps to a component/combo id (report the id table); [ ] exactly one owns_pin atom; [ ] all gated_by rules satisfied; [ ] no atom re-implemented that the library already has.
- REPORT schema additions: 'Library resolution table: layer -> component/combo id -> file:line where imported (not re-written).' This makes reuse auditable — the report proves the builder composed instead of reinvented.

Net effect: 'build an award section' becomes 'pick a combo, it pulls 4-5 atoms on one progress, write the content' — exactly the composition-first goal.
risks: Header drift: 13 RECIPEs + 16 rule/util headers are hand-maintained YAML that can desync from manifest.json. Mitigation: make manifest.json GENERATED from the headers (a build step), or make library-verify cross-check the two and fail on mismatch — pick one source of truth, do not maintain both by hand.

Shared/ becomes a dumping ground: the 8 cited-but-dir-less primitives (parallax-depth, splitLines, appear...) are the MOST-used moves in every combo; leaving them as second-class shared-utils undercuts the 'import don't reinvent' goal. They likely deserve promotion to full components/ with their own labs sooner than later, or the builder keeps hand-rolling them.

Combo-lab.html maintenance cost: a runnable section that imports 5 atoms by relative path is fragile to any atom refactor; if labs rot, the 'both altitudes reproduce' guarantee silently dies. Needs the verify script to at least smoke-load each lab (headless) in CI, not just assert the file exists.

Variant boundary is fuzzy: 'param preset vs structural override' will be argued every time; without a hard rule (e.g. override.css max N selectors, no JS fork ever) variants quietly become forks and the one-engine promise erodes.

page_beat taxonomy (hero/proof/material/lifestyle-climax/conversion/bridge) is asserted, not derived — if it doesn't match how the discovery/build commands actually plan pages, the builder can't map brief->beat->combo and the primary INDEX-combos lookup loses its key. Reconcile the beat vocabulary with award-re:build's page-architecture step before locking it.

Scope risk: this is a lot of net-new scaffolding (manifest, dual index, labs, verify, shared/, headers, variants) for a library with 6 atoms. Sequence it: headers + manifest + verify + INDEX first (unlocks the builder), shared/ and combo-labs second, full promotion of shared-utils last — don't block the first reuse on the whole schema existing.

owns_pin single-source: the law 'exactly one owns_pin per combo' is checkable in the combo header but a real section could still introduce a second pin in hand-written glue the manifest can't see — the runtime gate (hooks/ ScrollTrigger marker check) must remain the backstop; the header check is necessary not sufficient.

archs.angle: LEARN-LOOP-FIRST. The library is not a static asset folder you hand-curate — it is the OUTPUT of one command (/award-re:learn) and the INPUT to one agent (section-builder). Every schema decision is made to keep that single arc frictionless: an owner-approved prototype/recording goes IN, and a permanent, indexed, composable primitive comes OUT in ONE pass with zero manual filing — and the very next section build reaches it automatically. The 163 .md brain stays as the WHY/WHEN advisory layer; the library/ body becomes the WHAT/HOW reproducible layer; INDEX.md is the synapse the agent reads first. Concretely: learn WRITES five things atomically (component dir + RECIPE header + INDEX row + registry IMPLEMENTED-BY backlink + lab), section-builder READS INDEX→RECIPE→imports component before writing a line of new code, and the next learn pass reads its own INDEX so it never duplicates. The loop closes on itself; the plugin compounds.
archs.librarySchema:
library/ keeps its current 4 buckets, plus INDEX.md as the spine. Convention:

library/
  INDEX.md                         ← THE lookup (one row per variant, machine+human)
  components/<technique-id>/        ← one dir per TECHNIQUE (kebab id == registry/RECIPE id)
    RECIPE.md                       ← canonical recipe (header + phases + gotchas + verify) for the DEFAULT variant
    component.js                    ← parameterized IIFE/ESM primitive (self-contained, NO bundler)
    component.css                   ← tokenized (var(--xx) only; no hard values)
    lab.html                       ← runnable 1:1 demo wired to component.js + real renders
    tokens.json                    ← the parameter contract (every knob: name, type, default, range, unit)
    variants/<variant-id>/          ← ONLY present when >1 recording exists (see variantStrategy)
        RECIPE.md  params.json  lab.html   ← NO duplicated component.js
  combos/<combo-id>.md             ← Level-2 section recipe: references components by id (uses[] front-matter)
  rules/R_*.md                     ← gates (anti-combos, pin-budget, stackability, timing, theme-flow, perf)
  tokens/                          ← shared cross-component design tokens (eases, durations, type scale) — combos/components import names, never literals

Hard rules: id is the join key everywhere (folder name == RECIPE id == INDEX row == registry IMPLEMENTED-BY target). component.js stays a single self-contained module with a documented init(opts) signature (cards-swipe already does this). No file outside the technique dir is needed to run lab.html.
archs.recipeHeader:

library/INDEX.md is a single Markdown table — the ONE file the agent reads to decide what to reach for. One row per (technique × variant). Columns:

| T-ID(s) | technique-id / variant | component path | NW | status | combines-with | anti | meaning one-liner (when→lands) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-217,T-405 | cards-swipe / default | components/cards-swipe | ✅ | official | parallax-depth, splitLines | second-smoother | SHOW act, 3-4 equal beats as one cinematic gesture |

The first column (registry T-IDs) is the bridge back to _REGISTRY_TID.md; the meaning one-liner is the bridge to "WHEN to reach for it." section-builder greps this table by T-ID OR by intent keyword, lands on a component path, opens that RECIPE. INDEX is GENERATED, never hand-edited: a tiny scripts/index-build.mjs walks components/**/RECIPE.md front-matter and re-emits the table, so /award-re:learn just re-runs it (one row appears for free on every promotion).
archs.variantStrategy:
A technique is ONE component.js with parameters; a variant is a DIFFERENT POINT in that parameter space + its own recording, NOT a fork of code. Storage:

- The DEFAULT variant lives at components/<id>/RECIPE.md + tokens.json (the canonical recording, e.g. cards-swipe V1 1:1 Zera).
- Each additional variant is components/<id>/variants/<variant-id>/ containing ONLY: RECIPE.md (front-matter variant: cinematic, its own phases/gotchas/source-recording, what makes IT different) + params.json (the exact knob overrides vs default tokens.json) + lab.html (runnable, imports the SHARED ../../component.js with those params). NO component.js copy.
- Invariant: if a "variant" cannot be expressed as params.json over the shared component.js, it is NOT a variant — it is a new technique and gets its own components/<new-id>/. This is the guard against code-fork sprawl. (cards-swipe v2 cinematic / v3 editorial / v4 depth are valid variants only if they differ by ease/phase-windows/parallax/density — params. A genuinely different mechanic = new id.)
- INDEX gets one row per variant; the registry IMPLEMENTED-BY line points at the technique dir (variants inherit the same T-IDs). tokens.json (default) + params.json (each variant) together = full reproduction set for every recording.
archs.meaningCapture:
MEANING is captured in the RECIPE front-matter `meaning:` block as a strict triple the agent can match against a brief, NOT prose buried in paragraph 3:
- what  = the mechanic in one neutral sentence (HOW it moves)
- when  = the section-intent + content-shape that should trigger reaching for it (the SELECTOR — e.g. "SHOW act, 3-4 equal beats that must read as one gesture")
- lands = the felt outcome / the puant it delivers (the PAYOFF — ties to the catalog→dramaturgy lens: object=puant, scale-rhythm)

This triple is what makes the library answer "WHEN do I reach for this," not just "how do I build it." section-builder's selection step matches the project brief's section-intent against `when`, ranks candidates by `lands` fit, and only THEN reads `what`/phases to build. The 163 .md brain still owns the deep WHY (composition critique, antislop, the dramaturgy lens); the front-matter `meaning` is the indexed handle that points INTO that brain. Rule: learn refuses to promote a primitive whose `when`/`lands` are empty — a technique with no MEANING is unreproducible-on-purpose because nobody will know when to fire it.
archs.reproducibilityGuarantee:
100% reproduction = five things that must ALL be present and verified, enforced by scripts/library-verify.mjs (a new gate, sibling to the existing hooks):
1. Parameterized component.js with a documented init(opts) and NO hidden literals — every visual constant is an opt with a default.
2. tokens.json (default) + variants/*/params.json — the EXACT knob values of each recording. Re-running with the recorded params reproduces the recording; this is the "recipe" in the literal sense.
3. lab.html runnable with no bundler, wired to real renders — the executable proof. library-verify opens each lab headless and asserts: zero console.error, the acceptance[] assertions hold (e.g. exactly one pinned trigger, reverse-scroll symmetry, STATIC collapse at ≤760px).
4. RECIPE acceptance[] block = machine-checkable success criteria (loop-until-true), lifted from the current "How to verify" sections into the front-matter so the gate reads them.
5. Front-matter completeness: id/meaning/source/motion-props/acceptance/files all non-empty, and every listed file exists. library-verify fails the commit otherwise.
Guarantee chain: params reproduce the look + acceptance gates catch drift + headless lab is the witness + verify script blocks any primitive that can't be reproduced from its own files. No primitive enters status:official until library-verify passes green.
archs.brainLink:
Bidirectional, by id, with zero content duplication:

BODY → BRAIN (already half-there): RECIPE front-matter carries `layers: [T-IDs]` and `source.grammar`. The component is the IMPLEMENTATION of those registry rows; it does NOT restate the registry prose.

BRAIN → BODY (the missing half — add this): every _REGISTRY_TID.md row gets one optional trailing column, `IMPLEMENTED-BY`, holding the technique-id (or em-dash). T-217 → `cards-swipe`. _GRAMMAR.md and _TECHNIQUE_REGISTRY.md prose entries get an inline `→ library/components/<id>` pointer where a primitive now exists. So a reader of the brain is told "this advised technique is now CODE here," and a reader of the code is told "this is the WHY/WHEN, in registry §X."

INDEX.md is the synapse: its first column is registry T-IDs, its path column is the body. One grep on INDEX answers both "what realizes T-217?" and "what does components/cards-swipe realize?". The 163 .md are NEVER edited except to add the IMPLEMENTED-BY pointer (surgical, append-only) — verified map preserved. A scripts/link-check.mjs asserts every INDEX T-ID exists in the registry and every registry IMPLEMENTED-BY id has a component dir (catches drift in either direction).
archs.learnPipeline:
Add a 4th mode to commands/learn.md — `promote` (the growth loop), alongside the existing failure/video-bug/video-teardown modes. ONE pass, zero manual filing:

INPUT: an owner-approved prototype (a winning prototypes/*.html from /award-re:section) OR a recording (.mov) + the technique's intended id/name.

STEP 0 · DEDUP: read library/INDEX.md. If a matching id exists → this becomes a VARIANT (write variants/<new-id>/) not a new technique. Refuse silent duplicates. If recording, run scripts/frames.sh to extract phases (reuse existing frame pipeline).
STEP 1 · EXTRACT: parameterize the approved prototype → component.js (pull every literal up to an opt), tokens.json (the recorded values), component.css (literals → var()). For a variant: emit only params.json + variant RECIPE + lab.
STEP 2 · RECIPE: write RECIPE.md with the full front-matter header (id, meaning what/when/lands — PROMPT the owner for when/lands if not derivable; the loop will not promote without them), source.recording, layers (map to registry T-IDs), acceptance[] (lift from the section's verify gates).

STEP 6 · RECORD: CHANGELOG "promotion #N: <id>/<variant>"; commit + push plugin repo.

plan.executiveTake:
Build the DATABASE-FIRST spine (Architect 1) as the trunk, graft COMPOSITION-FIRST's dual-altitude insight (Architect 2) and LEARN-LOOP-FIRST's atomic write/read arc (Architect 3) onto it. Concretely:

THE TRUNK (A1): library/ becomes a queryable DB whose single machine entry point is a GENERATED INDEX.json (+ INDEX.md human mirror). Every technique = one folder with a strict YAML front-matter in RECIPE.md = the row. Variants nest under the folder as param/recipe deltas, never code forks. MEANING is structured fields. One scripts/library-verify.mjs is the 100%-reproduction gate (files exist + motion-props lint + headless lab __LAB_OK__ + variant imports base). Brain links by id, append-only. learn --promote is one atomic pass. section-builder must RESOLVE→IMPORT before writing.

THE GRAFTS:
- From A2 (correct, load-bearing): combos already outnumber components (7 vs 6) and cite primitives that have NO folder (parallax-depth, splitLines, appear, theme-flip, reveal, custom-cursor, counter, scroll-indicator). This is a REAL dangling-reference bug A1 missed. Fix = a shared/ bucket for cited-but-not-yet-atomic utilities so every combo `uses:` resolves, and verify FAILS on a dangling uses. Also adopt A2's dual lens in the index (a `kind` + `page_beat` column) so section-builder can look up BY SECTION JOB, not only by move — but keep it ONE index file, not two (A2's dual-file split adds drift surface; one INDEX with a kind column gives both lookups).
- From A3 (correct, load-bearing): the library is the OUTPUT of /award-re:learn and the INPUT of section-builder — design every field so learn writes it and the builder reads it in one hop. Adopt A3's DEDUP-FIRST step (read INDEX before promoting → new id vs variant) and the "refuse to promote without meaning.when/lands" gate. Adopt A3's append-only IMPLEMENTED-BY column in the registry as the brain-link (surgical, protects the 163 .md).

THE ONE HARD CORRECTION ALL THREE ARCHITECTS MISSED: the 6 existing components have FIVE DIFFERENT init signatures on disk (CardsSwipe.init(opts); ESM `mediaStepSwitch(stageSel,opts)`; FocusRenderSwitch.init(target,options); puzzle-text `init(el,userOpt)`; slide-out `init(root,opts)`). All three proposals assume a uniform `mount(root,opts)`. We must NOT rewrite code (owner's ZERO-rewrite constraint). Resolution: the RECIPE front-matter carries an `entry:` field that NAMES each component's actual call signature, and tokens.json documents that component's real knobs. The agent reads `entry` and calls the real signature. A uniform mount() is a FUTURE convergence target (new primitives adopt it; old ones get an optional thin adapter later), never a retrofit-now requirement.

Net: A1's database rigor + A2's composition/dangling-fix + A3's loop discipline + the entry-signature reality patch = a library that stores meaning+code, reproduces 100% via a runnable verify, holds variants as deltas, links to the 163 brain by id, grows by one learn command, and is reached by the builder — with zero code rewritten today.

plan.variantSpec:
One technique = one folder = MANY variants stored as DELTAS, never full code copies. Decision rule (encoded + machine-enforced):

- If a variant differs ONLY by knob values → params.json (data, zero code). PREFERRED.
- If a variant adds/removes a DOM layer or phase → variant.js that imports/reuses the base, patches; NEVER a wholesale fork.
- If it can't be expressed as params-over-base or a base-importing patch → it is NOT a variant, it's a NEW technique with its own components/<new-id>/. This is the anti-sprawl guard.

components/cards-swipe/
  component.js / component.css / tokens.json   ← the BASE = canonical default variant (V1 1:1 Zera, fully parameterized via its real entry signature)
  RECIPE.md                                     ← variants:[default,cinematic,editorial,depth]
  lab.html                                      ← default proof
  variants/
    cinematic/
      variant.recipe.md   ← extends:cards-swipe, variant:cinematic, meaning.lands delta, source.recording, overrides: block
      params.json         ← {scrubPerCard:1.4, blurFrom:20, ease:"air", theme:"dark"}   (the diff only)
      variant.lab.html    ← imports ../../component.js via the base entry signature, applies params
    editorial/  (params.json + variant.recipe.md + variant.lab.html)
    depth/      (params.json [+ variant.js only if a depth LAYER is genuinely new] + recipe + lab)

Enforcement (scripts/library-verify.mjs): every variant.recipe.md MUST carry `extends:` AND (params.json OR a variant.js that references the base). A variants/* dir containing a full copy of component.js = HARD FAIL. The parent row lists all variants in its `variants:` column; variants are NOT separate top-level INDEX rows (DB stays keyed by technique, browsable by variant). cards-swipe v2/v3/v4 = three params.json under one folder = the first official multi-variant entry, proving the mechanism on the very technique being recorded now. tokens.json (base) + each params.json = the full reproduction set for every recording.
plan.meaningSpec:
MEANING = a structured `meaning:` block in EVERY header (component, combo, variant-delta), four fields, each answering a planning question section-builder actually asks — so the plugin knows WHEN to reach for a technique, not only how to run it:

- what    → the one-sentence mechanic (HOW it moves; matches the existing "What it is" prose).
- when    → the SECTION SITUATION + content-shape that triggers reaching for it (the SELECTOR / lookup key: "SHOW act, 3-6 equal beats that must read as one gesture"). section-builder matches the section's job-to-be-done against this.
- lands   → the emotional/perceptual payoff (the puant: "page becomes a film"). The director's-pass ranks candidates by this; /audit checks "did the section land what its technique promised."
- not_when→ the anti-pattern guard (conversion gates, short factual, >half-pinned). Cross-checks rules/; prevents misuse.

Combo headers add one field: page_beat (hero|proof|material|lifestyle-climax|conversion|bridge) — maps the combo onto the page's dramaturgy so a whole page is laid out as a SEQUENCE of beats, one combo per beat, honoring R_theme_flow's temperature wave + R_pin_budget's "one pin in three."

These are NOT new doctrine: when/lands are the _TECHNIQUE_REGISTRY prose + the catalog-syndrome/dramaturgy lens compressed into machine fields; not_when mirrors R_anti_combos + pin-budget; registry_ref points back to the full prose for the human. Selection algorithm: planner reads section job → filters INDEX.json by when semantic match + timing_layer need (A/B/C) + page_beat → excludes not_when hits → ranks by lands vs director intent. HARD GATE: learn --promote REFUSES to mark status:official if meaning.when or meaning.lands is empty — a technique with no MEANING is unfireable, so it cannot enter the DB as official.
plan.reproSpec:
100% reproduction is GUARANTEED, not hoped, by FIVE artifacts that must ALL exist + pass one script before status:official:

1. PARAMETERIZED component.js — every visual constant is a knob with a default; no magic numbers inline. Same opts → same render deterministically. (Uses the component's REAL entry signature, declared in front-matter `entry.call` — we do NOT force a uniform mount() onto the 6 existing files.)
2. tokens.json — the explicit knob contract (name, type, default, range, unit, meaning) for THIS component's actual opts. Nothing undocumented. variants/*/params.json = the exact recorded knob values per variant. tokens.json + params.json = the literal "recipe" — re-run with these and you reproduce the recording.
3. lab.html — runnable standalone (file://, no bundler, real assets) that calls the component via `entry.call` and sets `window.__LAB_OK__=true` ONLY after the acceptance behaviors fire (dissolve completed, reverse replayed, ≤760px collapsed). Reproduction is OBSERVABLE.
4. acceptance[] in front-matter — human-readable pass conditions; each string maps to a probe in the lab (no orphan claims).
5. scripts/library-verify.mjs (the gate, sibling to the 3 existing hooks/) — for every INDEX row: (a) the contract files exist; (b) greps component.js for BANNED animated props (width/left/top/margin/video.currentTime) against motion_props — fail on violation; (c) opens each lab headless via the plugin's existing Playwright dep, asserts zero console.error + __LAB_OK__; (d) checks variant deltas carry extends+params/import and contain NO forked component.js; (e) checks every combo uses: resolves to a real component/shared id (closes A2's dangling gap) and exactly ONE uses entry is owns_pin; (f) checks required front-matter fields (entry, meaning.when, meaning.lands, source, acceptance) are non-empty.

STATUS lifecycle: seed → wip → candidate → official requires GREEN verify. deprecated keeps the row but section-builder won't auto-pick. A red verify = NOT reproducible = cannot be official = section-builder refuses to import it. WebGL primitives (OrbitStage) branch: webgl:true rows get a separate perf gate + a MANDATORY reduced-motion/mobile fallback acceptance line; until a GL-capable headless context exists they may sit at status:candidate (flagged so the builder doesn't auto-import an unverified GL mechanic).
plan.brainLinkSpec:
Bidirectional, by id, ZERO content duplication. The 163 .md stay the WHY/WHEN advisory layer (verified map, preserved); library/ is the WHAT/HOW reproducible body; INDEX is the synapse.

DOWN (brain → body) — APPEND-ONLY, protects the map:
- _REGISTRY_TID.md (109 T-IDs) + _TECHNIQUE_REGISTRY.md (~150 prose) each get ONE new trailing column `IMPLEMENTED-BY`: the library id (e.g. cards-swipe) or em-dash. T-217 → cards-swipe. This turns the prose registry into a COVERAGE MAP: which advised techniques now have reproducible code.
- skills that advise a technique (motion-engine E-entries, re-sections, variants-prototyping) get a one-line footer `IMPLEMENTED-BY: library/components/<id>/` where a primitive exists, so a skill-reading agent jumps straight to code.

UP (body → brain):
- every RECIPE front-matter carries source.registry_ref:[T-IDs] + source.grammar (originating site). From any code folder you walk back to the prose grammar that justifies it.
- gated_by:[R_*] cites the rule files by id; combines_with/anti_combos cite other library ids. The header is the join table.

RULES BRIDGE: the 8 rules/ files are the body-resident, machine-checkable enforcement of the brain's STACKING-GRAMMAR laws (R_anti_combos = §1 matrix; R_pin_budget = §3; R_theme_flow = §4; R_perf_limits = §5). Each rule gains a 5-line `gates:` front-matter naming the RECIPE fields it constrains, so a rule and the rows it polices are linked, and library-verify enforces it. The brain explains WHY a law exists; the rule file is the single canonical WHAT; the combo's gated_by is the WHERE.

GLUE / DRIFT-GUARD: scripts/library-index.mjs ALSO emits COVERAGE.md (registry T-IDs with no impl = build backlog; library entries with no registry_ref = orphans). scripts/link-check.mjs asserts every INDEX registry_ref exists in the registry AND every registry IMPLEMENTED-BY id has a real folder — catching drift in either direction. The 163 .md are NEVER edited except to append IMPLEMENTED-BY (surgical, single column); link-check asserts no other lines changed before push. Nothing is duplicated: prose lives once in the brain, code once in the body, id-links + two generated reports keep them honest.

INPUT: an owner-approved prototype (a winning prototypes/*.html from /award-re:section or variants-prototyping) OR a reference recording (.mov) the owner blessed; + the intended id/name.

STEP 0 · DEDUP (A3's discipline) — read library/INDEX.json FIRST. If a matching id exists → this becomes a VARIANT (write variants/<new-id>/), not a new technique. Refuse silent duplicates. For a recording, run scripts/frames.sh to extract phases (reuse the existing frame pipeline + the cards-swipe 7-phase method).
STEP 1 · CLASSIFY altitude — single MOVE → component/variant; STACK of moves on one progress → combo; cited-but-not-atomic util → shared/. Heuristic: count pin-owners/clocks; >1 atom on one progress = combo.
STEP 2 · EXTRACT — lift magic numbers into tokens.json, keep the component's REAL entry signature (declare it in `entry:`; do NOT rewrite to mount()), split component.js/.css. Variant of an existing engine → emit ONLY params.json + variant.recipe.md + variant.lab.html (no engine copy). Combo → combos/<id>/RECIPE.md + combo-lab.html importing atoms by relative path.
STEP 3 · RECIPE — write the full front-matter: meaning.what/when/lands/not_when (PROMPT the owner for when/lands if not derivable — REFUSE to proceed to official without them), source.recording + registry_ref, motion_props, combines_with via the stackability matrix, acceptance[] from observed behaviors, entry.call. status:seed.
STEP 4 · LAB — emit lab.html / variant.lab.html / combo-lab.html wired to real assets + the __LAB_OK__ probe mapping each acceptance string.
STEP 5 · VERIFY — run scripts/library-verify.mjs on the new folder headless; loop until GREEN (this IS the 100%-reproduction gate). Red → stays candidate/wip, report why, DO NOT promote. Green → flip status:official.
STEP 6 · REGISTER (atomic, all-or-nothing) — re-run scripts/library-index.mjs (new INDEX row or variant added to parent + INDEX.json + COVERAGE update); append IMPLEMENTED-BY in _REGISTRY_TID.md for each realized T-ID; add the IMPLEMENTED-BY skill footer; run scripts/link-check.mjs.
STEP 7 · RULES — if the new technique introduces a new collision, append to R_anti_combos / partners' combines_with (same constitution-escalation path the failure mode already uses).
STEP 8 · RECORD — CHANGELOG "library ingestion #N: <id>/<variant>"; commit + push the plugin repo. Output to owner: the new INDEX row + the verify-green report + "section-builder can now import <id>."

Because section-builder reads INDEX fresh each build, the new primitive is reachable the very next section — the loop compounds.
